acip: SNYING GA'I PHYOGS KYI RTZA 'DAB BZHI LAS 'BYUNG BA BZHI'I RLUNG RGYU BAS 'BYUNG BA'I RTZA DANG , MTSAMS KYI RTZA BZHI LAS GZUGS DRI RO REG BYA BZHI 'BAB PAS MCHOD PA'I RTZA ZHES BSHAD CING , BSHANG GCI KHU KHRAG BAD KAN TE BDUD RTZI LNGA 'BAB PAR YANG BSHAD DO,,
wylie: snying ga'i phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi las 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu bas 'byung ba'i rtsa dang , mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi las gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi 'bab pas mchod pa'i rtsa zhes bshad cing , bshang gci khu khrag bad kan te bdud rtsi lnga 'bab par yang bshad do
english: Now because the winds of the four elements flow through the four channel petals of the heart that correspond to the cardinal directions, these channels themselves are also spoken of as the "channels of the elements."  And because the four of visible, smellable, tastable, and tangible objects flow through the four channels of the ordinal directions, these are also known as the "channels of offering."  It is also said that feces, urine, semen, blood, and phlegm--the five nectars--flow through these channels.
